name: Process: Run the coaching module for the founders and the first leads before the first check-in they hold
markdown_description:
I5 as a process. Before the cohort's first check-in, two weeks after the first paid hour, every lead who will hold one has completed the coaching module on scheduled shift and carries its training record state on their page; the founders complete it pre-opening beside their interviewer training (`86akh9tar`), because the first leads' own check-ins have no holder until `86akhb2jg` closes and the founders are the only people in the building who could hold one. The module teaches the sources and the refused sources, the shape of a hypothesis, the two openings, the observation as situation, behavior, and impact, the one line, the placed check-in and the placed line, the live call's grammatical test, the recognition decline, and the not-yet reading, with the refusals as sentences a lead never says. Extends `86akhb2kw` and `86akh9tar` by reference. High.

Filed by Session 12 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmjba`. Reasoning lives on the S12 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
